verdict.rationale: Passkey support is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents syncing TOTP/HOTP verification codes across devices via a Google Account. It never mentions passkeys, let alone cross-ecosystem passkey sync across iOS, Android, Windows, Linux and browsers. OTP code sync is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
